# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(pheatmap)
library(viridis)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(scDblFinder)
```



# Read in the data

```{r, include=FALSE}
WT_data <- Read10X_h5("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_muscle/data_Zhang_snKIC/GSM8392727_WT_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")

KIC_data <- Read10X_h5("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_muscle/data_Zhang_snKIC/GSM8392728_Cachexia_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
```

### NOTE - I am not using SoupX to remove ambient signals because all of the datasets were FACS sorted before hand (except Pryce et al. 2024 which was MACS sorted). This approach is stated in the McKellar codes. Pre-sorting removes a large amount of ambient signals. 



# Extract only gene expression data and remove ATACseq

```{r, include-FALSE}
WT_rna <- as(WT_data[["Gene Expression"]], "dgCMatrix")
KIC_rna <- as(KIC_data[["Gene Expression"]], "dgCMatrix")
```



# Create Seurat Object

```{r, include=FALSE}
WT_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = WT_rna, min.cells = 3, project = "zhang_snKIC_CTL")
KIC_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = KIC_rna, min.cells = 3, project = "Zhang_snKIC_KIC")
```



# 1. QC

## % mitochondrial reads

```{r, include=FALSE}
WT_seurat[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(WT_seurat, pattern = "^mt-")
KIC_seurat[["percent.mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(KIC_seurat, pattern = "^mt-")
```



# 2. Filtering

```{r, include=FALSE}
WT_filtered <- subset(WT_seurat, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 60000 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 15000 & percent.mito < 10)
KIC_filtered <- subset(KIC_seurat, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 60000 & nCount_RNA > 500 & nCount_RNA < 15000 & percent.mito < 10)
```



# 3. Pre-process

```{r, include=FALSE}
all_genes_WT <- rownames(WT_filtered)
all_genes_KIC <- rownames(KIC_filtered)
```


## WT

```{r, include=FALSE}
DefaultAssay(WT_filtered) <- "RNA"
all_genes_WT <- rownames(WT_filtered)

WT_norm <- WT_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_WT) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(WT_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
WT_norm <- WT_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:41) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:41)
```


## KIC

```{r, include=FALSE}
KIC_norm <- KIC_filtered %>%
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000) %>%
  ScaleData(features = all_genes_KIC) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 50)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(KIC_norm, ndims = 50) ### to check dims
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
KIC_norm <- KIC_norm %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:41) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:41)
```



# 4. scDblFinder

```{r, include=FALSE}
WT_dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(WT_norm, slot = "counts"), clusters = Idents(WT_norm))

WT_norm$scDblFinder.class <- WT_dbl$scDblFinder.class


KIC_dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(KIC_norm, slot = "counts"), clusters = Idents(KIC_norm))

KIC_norm$scDblFinder.class <- KIC_dbl$scDblFinder.class
```


## See numbers of singlets vs. doublets

```{r}
table(WT_norm$scDblFinder.class)
table(KIC_norm$scDblFinder.class)
```


## Remove Doublets

```{r, include=FALSE}
WT_singlets <- subset(WT_norm, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")

KIC_singlets <- subset(KIC_norm, subset = scDblFinder.class == "singlet")
```



# 5. Combine conditions

## Merge data

```{r, include=FALSE}
ordered_datasets <- c(WT_singlets, KIC_singlets)

features_merge <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = ordered_datasets)
```


## Find anchors

```{r, include=FALSE}
anchors_merge <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = list(WT_singlets, KIC_singlets), anchor.features = features_merge)
```


## Combine data

```{r, include=FALSE}
Zhang_snKIC <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors_merge)

DefaultAssay(Zhang_snKIC) <- "integrated"
```


## Remove unused objects to improve processing

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(anchors_merge, WT_data, WT_dbl, WT_filtered, WT_norm, WT_seurat, WT_singlets, KIC_data, KIC_dbl, KIC_filtered, KIC_norm, KIC_seurat, KIC_singlets, ordered_datasets, all_genes_WT, all_genes_KIC, features_merge, WT_rna, KIC_rna)
```
